title: 3D BAG
description:
All ~10.8 million buildings in the Netherlands as detailed 3D models, produced by the [3D Geoinformation Research Group](https://3d.bk.tudelft.nl/) at TU Delft in collaboration with [3DGI](https://3dgi.xyz/). The [3D BAG](https://3dbag.nl/) enriches the official [BAG building registry](https://www.pdok.nl/introductie/-/article/basisregistratie-adressen-en-gebouwen-ba-1) (maintained by Kadaster) with building heights, roof types, volumes, and surface areas derived from the [AHN](https://www.ahn.nl/) national point cloud survey.

The source BAG footprints and attributes (construction year, function, status) are available in this catalog as [Buildings (Panden)](../kadaster/panden/collection.json) from Kadaster. The 3D BAG adds computed height fields that enable 2.5D extrusion rendering, plus detailed 3D metrics (volumes, roof/wall areas, floor counts) for energy modelling, urban planning, and environmental simulation.

This collection provides LOD 1.3 building-part geometries (~14.1M parts for ~10.8M buildings) with pre-computed `height` and `base_height` fields ready for [MapLibre GL fill-extrusion](https://maplibre.org/maplibre-style-spec/layers/#fill-extrusion) rendering. A separate whole-building file contains the full set of 58 3D-derived attributes for advanced analysis.

Funded by the European Research Council (ERC). Updated regularly as new AHN releases become available.

table:columns.name: identificatie
table:columns.description: BAG building ID (16-char pand ID). Links to the Kadaster BAG registry. First 4 digits encode the municipality code.

table:columns.name: b3_pand_deel_id
table:columns.description: Building-part ID within a building. Buildings are split where roof heights differ.

table:columns.name: b3_dd_id
table:columns.description: Sub-part ID within a building part.

table:columns.name: height
table:columns.description: Building part height in meters (roof 70th percentile minus ground elevation). Use as fill-extrusion-height for 3D rendering.

table:columns.name: base_height
table:columns.description: Base elevation relative to ground in meters. Use as fill-extrusion-base for stepped building parts in 3D rendering.

table:columns.name: bouwjaar
table:columns.description: Original construction year from BAG. Value of 9999 means unknown.

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: Building lifecycle status from BAG (e.g. 'Pand in gebruik', 'Bouw gestart').

table:columns.name: gebruiksdoel
table:columns.description: Building usage function from BAG (e.g. 'woonfunctie', 'kantoorfunctie'). Comma-separated for mixed use.

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_min
table:columns.description: Minimum floor area (m²) of contained dwelling units.

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_max
table:columns.description: Maximum floor area (m²) of contained dwelling units.

table:columns.name: aantal_verblijfsobjecten
table:columns.description: Number of dwelling units in the building.

lod13-data.title: 3D BAG LOD 1.3 Building Parts (GeoParquet)
lod13-data.description: 14.1M building-part polygons with height and base_height fields for 3D extrusion, plus BAG attributes. EPSG:7415 (RD New + NAP height). 747 MB.

pand-data.title: 3D BAG Whole Buildings (GeoParquet)
pand-data.description: 10.8M whole-building polygons with 62 attributes including volumes, surface areas, floor counts, roof types, and AHN quality metrics. EPSG:7415. 1.3 GB. Join to LOD 1.3 parts on identificatie.

pmtiles.title: 3D BAG LOD 1.3 (vector tiles)
pmtiles.description: Vector tiles of building parts with height data for 3D extrusion rendering. EPSG:4326. 1.2 GB.

tilejson.title: TileJSON endpoint (CloudFront)
tilejson.description: TileJSON 3.0 document served via AWS CloudFront, backed by Protomaps-on-Lambda reading the PMTiles archive on Source Cooperative. Use this URL directly with MapLibre GL, Mapbox GL, deck.gl, OpenLayers, or Leaflet vector-tile plugins.

xyz.title: XYZ vector tile endpoint (CloudFront)
xyz.description: Direct {z}/{x}/{y} MVT endpoint served via AWS CloudFront. Min zoom 0, max zoom 15. Layers: 'buildings' (z10–15, full attributes) and 'buildings-overview' (z0–12, simplified).

styles/default.title: Default (3D Extruded)
styles/default.description: Light grey 3D extruded buildings with height-based shading.

styles/by-height.title: By Building Height
styles/by-height.description: Color ramp from cool blue (low) to warm red (tall) with 3D extrusion.

styles/by-age.title: By Construction Year
styles/by-age.description: Dark brown (pre-1800) through orange to pale yellow (post-2000) with 3D extrusion.

styles/by-use.title: By Building Function
styles/by-use.description: Categorical colors by gebruiksdoel with 3D extrusion.

styles/by-roof-type.title: By Roof Type
styles/by-roof-type.description: Categorical colors by dak_type with 3D extrusion.

styles/flat.title: Flat (2D Overview)
styles/flat.description: 2D flat fill view for performance and overview mapping.
